fieldData.main-content:
After the success of CES Las Vegas in January, RDX Works is excited to announce we will be exhibiting at SXSW in Austin Texas!

From the 13th to 15th of March RDX Works team members (core developers of the Radix Public Network) will be at SXSW showcasing the revolutionary Scrypto programming language, and illustrating how Radix is the only decentralized network capable of scaling to consume the $400 trillion global financial system. 

South by Southwest is an excellent opportunity to excite a broad mass of potential users and developers about Radix and Scrypto.

The team will be at Booth 631 of the Creative Industries Expo from March 13th -16th, between 10:00 am and 5:00 pm CT. 

“As the largest exhibition at SXSW, the Creative Industries Expo is the hands-on, experiential showcase that brings the conference conversations to life with endless unexpected discovery opportunities.” - sxsw.com

‍

Members of the Scrypto team will be running live “code along” sessions to give participants an in-depth insight into Scrypto, along with interactive presentations (with Ipad mini giveaways) allowing everyone in attendance to learn more about the only decentralized network that lets you build fast, rewards everyone who makes it better, and scales without friction. 

For participants in the Scrypto code-along sessions, we are giving away a Razer R1 package worth $5000! 

If you are at SXSW and get lost, just look up, we will be easy to spot!


For those that cannot make it we have a camera crew on standby to send a steady stream of footage back to base.
